messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate and 95th pct latency spike for tenant Northbridge Capital in dedicated-vpc-us-west-2 pool. Root cause suspected: model runtime OOMs on variant v3-alpha. Impact: 60% of requests returning 5xx, streaming hangs. Severity: P1. Pager routed to oncall (marcus).
marcus (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Can someone pull the most recent tenant routing & override config?
sara (sre): Looking. Tenant routing shows: `route_policy: pinned_model: northbridge-v3-alpha` and `fallback_policy: deny_safe_variant`. So customer pinned and disallowed safe fallback.
jamal (support): Customer reporting "timeouts in checkout" via support ticket #NB-4721. They've seen failures since ~09:01a PT. They're on a paid Dedicated contract and asked for immediate mitigation. Lia, can SE reach out for permission to change pin?
lia (se): Reached out on call with Northbridge infra team (on phone). They say they pinned v3-alpha intentionally due to inference differences with v2, but they give permission to allow safe fallback for the duration if we can guarantee request-level parity on schema. They asked for a config change log.
omer (deploy-bot): Deploy logs: `2026-03-15T16:01:03Z redwood-runtime[pool:d-vpc-usw2]: model v3-alpha OOM shard 2/8` then repeated memory pressure and stream resets.
marcus (oncall): Ok plan: 1) Temporarily allow safe-variant fallback for northbridge to stop 5xxs 2) If that reduces errors, schedule controlled rollback/pin to stable v2 for longer term 3) Postmortem + config change approval. Who can apply override? Need explicit admin command so we have an audit trail.
sara (sre): I can run the override command, but we must capture customer consent. Lia confirmed consent on call (timestamped). Command to run: 
```
# grant tenant temporary fallback to safe variant
redwoodctl tenant override --tenant northbridge-capital --set "fallback_policy=allow_safe_variant" --expires-in 60m --reason "prod outage, customer consented via SE lia"
```
marcus (oncall): Run it. Jamal mirror with customer-facing message.
jamal (support): Messaging to customer: "We're enabling a temporary safe-variant fallback to restore traffic. This may change latencies slightly but will reduce errors. We'll closely monitor and keep you updated." Sending now.
lia (se): Customer confirms: "Proceed, restore traffic pls."
sara (sre): Running command now...
sara (sre): ✅ override applied. API response: `200 OK - override_id=ovr-2481234567-9a`
sara (sre): Observability: within 45s error rate dropped to 2%, 95th latency dropped from 2.8s -> 0.95s. Traces show most requests now hitting `northbridge-safe-v1` model variant.
marcus (oncall): Good. Marking immediate mitigation as success. Next: decide whether to pin to stable v2 or let fallback remain while we investigate OOM. Lia, can you ask engineering contact for any special data that required v3-alpha?
lia (se): On it. They say v3-alpha was pinned for a small post-processing plugin that expects new tokenization. We can try a targeted canary of v2 with plugin shim. Customer asks for minimal change.
omer (deploy-bot): Autoscaling note: dedicated pool autoscaler increased nodes +2 during the spike but OOM persisted on v3-alpha due to memory growth per-request (attention cache growth).
sara (sre): I'm capturing runtime heap dumps and model memory charts and will post to the incident doc. For now we will keep fallback allowed, expire override in 60m as per command. If customer agrees, we can do a controlled pin to `northbridge-v2-stable` instead of `v3-alpha`.
marcus (oncall): Lia, get written approval for pin change. Also we need the oncall handoff window: I'll be handing off in ~40m. Sara, prep the full mitigation notes and a concise bullet list for next oncall. Jamal, update support ticket with mitigation and ETA for SOC/SE follow-up.
jamal (support): Updated ticket NB-4721 with timeline and override_id. Adding customer contact `ops@northbridge.com`.
lia (se): Customer approves pin to v2-stable for next 24h for verification. They want a smoke test URL and to be notified before we flip routing for all traffic.
sara (sre): Proposed safe pin command (needs approval): 
```
# pin tenant to stable variant with canary routing 10% then ramp
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant northbridge-capital --model northbridge-v2-stable --canary 10 --ramp 30m --reason "post-incident stabilization"
```
marcus (oncall): Good. Lia/Oliver (AM) please confirm business approval.
oliver (am): Confirmed with account team; customer approved canary + ramp. I'll coordinate the notification.
marcus (oncall): Logging timeline: 
- 2481234567 (16:01:07Z): Pager fired, initial ack.
- 16:03Z: Customer contacted and consented to fallback.
- 16:05Z: Override applied (ovr-2481234567-9a).
- 16:06Z: Error rates improved.
- 16:45Z: Planned canary pin to v2-stable (pending ops window).
marcus (oncall): Handoff at 16:50Z to sara. I'll include runbook pointers and the override id.
sara (sre): Taking next oncall from 16:50Z. I'll monitor for the remainder of the override window and coordinate the canary if we get green light. Prep notes saved to incident doc: `/incidents/2481234567-northbridge-override` (internal link).
jamal (support): Closing loop with customer message: "We've enabled a temporary safe fallback and will begin a controlled canary to v2-stable in the approved window. We'll notify you 15 minutes prior to ramp."
lia (se): Quick note for postmortem: customer-specified pin + deny_safe_variant removed our automated fallback. For dedicated tenants we should consider alerting when pinned variants are unhealthy for >2m and auto-suggest a manual override with audit capture.
marcus (oncall): Agreed. Sara, please add that as an action item in RCA. Also include recommended changes to our console UX: show warning banners when pinned model health < 80% for >1m.
sara (sre): Will do. Capturing the primary action items now: [1] RCA memory leak investigation for v3-alpha, [2] UX banner for pinned-model health, [3] policy to suggest safe fallback when pinned variants degrade in dedicated pools, [4] draft permission flow for emergency overrides (customer consent capture).
marcus (oncall): End of handoff notes: next oncall Sara. If anything regresses escalate to SE+AM immediately.
sara (sre): Acknowledged. Monitoring dashboards look stable. Will follow up with full incident timeline and postmortem once we complete memory investigation.
incbot: Incident closed: mitigation succeeded, override expired at 17:05Z, canary scheduled for 17:15Z. Postmortem requested by P1 policy.
sara (sre): Posting link to postmortem once created.
marcus (oncall): Thanks team. Great run.
